# orbivisor_folder (Resource)

A folder in the VM, network or storage tree (permissions and quotas follow it). `folder` is the parent path.

Manifest kind `Folder`: the attributes are the manifest spec's fields in the server's JSON shape. Attributes left out keep the server's value; removing one sets the server default.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "orbivisor_folder" "prod" {
  name  = "prod"
  kind  = "vm"
  quota = { vcpus = 64, memory_mib = 262144 }
}

resource "orbivisor_folder" "web" {
  name   = "web"
  kind   = "vm"
  folder = "/${orbivisor_folder.prod.name}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) Tree: `vm`, `network` or `storage`.
- `name` (String) Name (unique per kind; DNS label). Changing it replaces the object.

### Optional

- `folder` (String) Parent folder path (`/prod`); empty is the tree's root. Changing it replaces the folder.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels. Terraform owns the object's labels: labels set elsewhere are removed on the next apply (server labels `orbivisor.io/…` stay).
- `quota` (Dynamic) Quota for the folder and everything under it, e.g. `{ vcpus = 16, memory_mib = 65536 }`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The manifest key: the name (folders `tree:/path`, grants the grant's content).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The key is tree:path.
terraform import orbivisor_folder.web vm:/prod/web
```
